description: Toughen 可以表示『使更強、更耐受、更有韌性、更硬、更耐用，或使人適應艱苦環境』。 這些 sense 不能完全互換。替換前要判斷：是要增加 strength, resilience, hardness, structural support, protection, conditioning, durability, 還是 robustness？

options.explanation: Strengthen ✓ — make stronger or more effective. Here, general increase in physical strength is central. This makes Strengthen the most precise replacement for this sense of toughen.

Reinforce — make stronger by adding support or extra strength. It usually implies added support or extra structural strength. The decisive clue is that general increase in physical strength is central.
Build up — increase strength, tolerance, or capacity gradually. It specifically suggests gradual development over time. The decisive clue is that general increase in physical strength is central.
Repair — restore something that is damaged. It restores existing damage rather than increasing future resistance. The decisive clue is that general increase in physical strength is central.

Protect — keep safe from harm, often through external measures. It can keep something safe externally without making the thing itself tougher. The decisive clue is that general increase in physical strength is central.
Weaken — make less strong. It is the opposite meaning. The decisive clue is that general increase in physical strength is central.

options.explanation: Make more robust ✓ — make better able to withstand stress, failure, or demanding use. Here, technical system robustness is central. This makes Make more robust the most precise replacement for this sense of toughen.

Strengthen — make stronger or more effective. It is broader and does not necessarily capture resilience, hardness, reinforcement, adaptation, or durability. The decisive clue is that technical system robustness is central.

Make more resilient — increase the ability to withstand difficulty or disruption and recover. It focuses on withstanding shocks and recovery, not every kind of strengthening. The decisive clue is that technical system robustness is central.
Repair — restore something that is damaged. It restores existing damage rather than increasing future resistance. The decisive clue is that technical system robustness is central.

Protect — keep safe from harm, often through external measures. It can keep something safe externally without making the thing itself tougher. The decisive clue is that technical system robustness is central.
Weaken — make less strong. It is the opposite meaning. The decisive clue is that technical system robustness is central.

exercises.original: The new architecture toughens the service against sudden traffic spikes.
exercises.zh: 新架構令服務面對突然流量高峰時更穩健。

falseSynonyms.zh: 較廣，不一定等於 toughen strengthen 只要求變強，不一定涉及耐衝擊、耐磨或復原力。
只在變硬／抗攻擊 sense 接近 harden 可能增加硬度，但硬度與 toughness 並不是完全相同的材料性質。
修復 ≠ toughen repair 是把已損壞部分恢復，不等於提升未來耐受能力。
保護 ≠ toughen protect 可透過外部防護做到，不一定讓本體變得更強韌。
訓練 ≠ toughen train 是過程，只有在提升耐受力的情境才可能相關。
加固 ≠ 所有 toughen reinforce 常加入支撐或額外材料。
形容詞 ≠ toughen resilient 是形容詞；make more resilient 才能對應動詞 toughen。
詞形陷阱 tough 是形容詞；toughen 是動詞；toughness 是名詞。
